_comment: Consumed by .github/workflows/red-green-gate.yml. Every entry is compared WHOLE-FILE: the test lives in its own file (a sibling tests.rs for the inline modules, the test file itself for frontend, tests/ for the integration case), so byte-identity needs no region heuristic. Values must be shell-safe (no double quotes, backticks, dollar signs or backslashes). test_path is frontend-relative for kind=frontend and repo-relative otherwise. The _evidence fields are documentation only; the gate reads exactly: branch, kind, red, green, test_path, test_target, filter, expect_red, expect_green.

_evidence.split: the inline `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` moved verbatim into this file: the new file's sha256 ed68aa88667f386720911f7a8158e6a3a36ed04ba8399545ca182ec00199ff46 is byte-identical to the old module BODY, while the old region AS THE GATE EXTRACTED IT (wrapper lines included, 351 lines) hashed e778f3d98d157b15... — the two differ by construction, so only one is the gate's hash. The parent changed by exactly one added declaration line (`#[cfg(test)] #[rustfmt::skip] mod tests;`) with production lines 1-185 byte-identical
_evidence.rustfmt_skip_cost: the declaration carries #[rustfmt::skip] because rustfmt reprints an out-of-line `mod tests;` as a crate root and would demand the whole body be outdented to column 0 — which would break the byte-identity this entry exists to prove. Cost, stated rather than implied: rustfmt no longer reformats this file. Verified: `cargo fmt --all -- --check` is clean at RED and at HEAD with the skip attribute, and reports a diff without it
_evidence.red_run: exit 101; FAILED. 3 passed; 2 failed; the named assertion panicked with observed Retry-After 6 and 6 (the configured window) where the test requires second < first
_evidence.green_run: exit 0; ok. 5 passed; 0 failed; surrounding recipient_notification module 5 passed
_evidence.clock_note: no injectable clock pre- or post-patch, so a real window boundary is driven by sleep (3 s, and 2+3 s on separate threads)

branches.expect_red: the setup route consumed the register budget

_evidence.base: NOT C0: stacked on the verified limiter pair — 7f4b2a7f then 67e6f76d then this branch's own pair
_evidence.red_run: exit 101: setup attempts [400,400,429,429,429] then register after: 429, assertion left != right; the pre-fix startup line has no setup: budget
_evidence.green_run: exit 0: register after the setup burst 400, and the startup line gains setup: 2/3600 s
_evidence.rustfmt: the test file is now rustfmt-clean; the RED commit was rebuilt to carry the formatting so the file stays identical at RED and GREEN (a later commit would have broken the whole-file identity)
_evidence.skip_hole: with no DB URL the test prints SKIP and passes; libtest captures a passing test's stdout, so a raw log shows nothing. The gate therefore passes --nocapture, fails closed on an unset URL, refuses SKIP, and requires the behavioural marker setup: 2/3600 s rather than the test name

_evidence.red_run: exit 1; Tests 4 failed | 24 passed (28); the new test fails on its own assertion — expected 'NetworkError' not to be 'NetworkError'
_evidence.green_run: exit 0; Tests 28 passed (28); npm run check rc=0
_evidence.deliberate_omission: no status assertion: a bare-string throw carries status 0 in BOTH states, so status cannot discriminate; errorType is the observable that does

_evidence.split: the inline module moved verbatim; the moved body's sha256 d1ff2cf255049cdef00f1d5596bbe385989ab43424e0f512d80b2dff92de901d is the old inline body, and the parent changed by one added declaration line with production lines 1-2067 byte-identical (the pre-existing registration_domain_gate_tests module stays where it was)
_evidence.filter_change: the old filter named the module (`setup_openapi_contract`), which the moved body cannot satisfy — the body has no `mod` declaration inside it. The filter is now the test function `committed_spec_declares_the_setup_contract`, declared in the new file, so the legs select exactly one test and expect_green becomes `1 passed`
_evidence.red_run: exit 101; FAILED. 0 passed; 2 failed at the old pair; with the new single-test filter the named assertion fails naming the missing status 400 against the declared set 201/403/503
_evidence.green_run: exit 0 with the artifact regenerated (openapi.json 40bb734e..., byte-identical to the published branch); the artefact layer is separately checked, see the 2x2 probe in the evidence document
_evidence.ts_sdk: this branch also carries the regenerated TypeScript SDK (a follow-up commit), which the artifact layer of ci.yml's drift job requires; without it that job fails on sdk.gen.ts/types.gen.ts
